item.title: Okinawa Beaches Guide: West Coast, Manzamo & Resorts
item.description: Okinawa’s west coast is the island’s resort belt — a string of white-sand beaches, turquoise lagoons and clifftop scenery running through Onna Village and beyond. Highlights include the elephant-trunk rock of Cape Manzamo, the calm waters of Manza, and a line of resort beaches perfect for swimming, snorkelling and unforgettable west-facing sunsets. With easy access from Naha and the airport, this coast is where most beach holidays in Okinawa happen.
